correctness.rationale: The alternating K-bilinear bracket gives three minors in K^3; commutativity is K-collinearity. All abelian k-subalgebras are contained in precisely one projective preimage unless central, giving exact inclusion-exclusion. Ideal closure forces D or Z according to highest nonzero coordinate; these strata exhaust ideals. K-linear GL2 substitutions and triangular shears act transitively on the nonderived projective points, while D is characteristic. The standalone verifier directly checks q=2,m=2 including 1,048,576 pairs and all 137 ideals; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem simultaneously determines two complete intrinsic subalgebra lattices and their exact dimension spectra throughout a natural infinite class-three family motivated by a recent classification. A K-projective spread inside a k-vector space makes the incidence structure nontrivial for m>=2; the unique maximal abelian ideal and two Aut-orbit decomposition add structural content beyond a maximum dimension or an isolated numerical calculation. It provides an explicit benchmark for ideal zeta and automorphism-orbit problems of larger class-three algebras.
